# YAAGAM

YAAGAM is an Indian devotional-services platform for discovering temples and booking Vedic poojas. Users can choose a pooja, provide authorised Sankalp details, complete payment, and receive service updates and applicable Prasad delivery information.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://www.yaagam.in/
- Poojas: https://www.yaagam.in/poojas
- Temples: https://www.yaagam.in/temples
- Privacy Policy: https://www.yaagam.in/privacy-policy
- Terms and Conditions: https://www.yaagam.in/terms-and-conditions
- Refund and Cancellation Policy: https://www.yaagam.in/refund-cancellation-policy
- Service Partner and Vendor Code: https://www.yaagam.in/service-partner-vendor-code-of-conduct

## Languages

The public devotional catalogue is available in English, Malayalam, Hindi, Marathi, and Tamil. English URLs are prefixless; translated catalogue pages use /ml, /hi, /mr, and /ta prefixes.

## Contact

- Website: https://www.yaagam.in/
- Email: support@yaagam.in
